title: Logarithmic-program instructions
statement: For natural numbers $m,d$ and a label type $\Lambda$, define instructions for a program with $m$ registers and $d$ deciders, whose branch targets are labels in $\Lambda$. The instructions increment a register, decrement it with truncated subtraction, clear it, halve it, branch on whether it is zero or odd, branch on equality of two distinct registers, call a decider on a virtual input specified by a mode and register arguments, or return a Boolean answer and halt. They also include checks that the input has the required unary and canonical binary encoding, branches testing whether a register's binary expansion matches a specified input component, and branches on equality with the first or second binary component of a nested input encoding.
